note: encoded.js is the VM encoder's output for source.js with default options, which draw no randomness, with the leading disassembly comment block removed (the committed corpus format). Regenerating with the same encoder revision reproduces the bytes.

cells.f-switch-flow: one function per switch shape whose case bodies share routes: pick, a case falling into the next between breaking cases and a default; group, grouped empty cases and a default in the middle falling into the last case; walk, cases falling through inside a for loop with a case that continues; each run with inputs that take every route
